title: Creativity — Part Two

sentences.en: Now listen to part two of the interview.
sentences.zh: 现在请听访谈的第二部分。
sentences.asr_text: Now listen to part two of the interview.

sentences.asr_text: Questions six to ten are based on part two of the interview.
sentences.speaker: announcer

sentences.en: I see. Another question, do you think there is a creative personality?
sentences.zh: 我明白了。另一个问题是，您认为存在具有创造力的人格特征吗？
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.en: Well, perhaps we can put it this way.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以这样说。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: Gifted people in the arts or science tend to enjoy adventure.
sentences.zh: 艺术或科学领域有天赋的人，往往喜欢冒险。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: They often like to explore new places or ideas.
sentences.zh: 他们常常喜欢探索新的地方或想法。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: Uh, they don’t like being hemmed in by rules or convention and, and they often look at problems from a different angle.
sentences.zh: 他们不喜欢受规则或惯例束缚，而且常常从不同角度看问题。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: Another point is, is they often have to move doggedly ahead on a project—even when the outside world rejects their art or new ideas.
sentences.zh: 还有一点是，他们经常必须顽强地推动项目继续前进，即使外界不接受他们的艺术或新想法也是如此。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: Dr. Andreasen, what about the role of the environment in the creative process?
sentences.zh: 安德烈亚森博士，环境在创造过程中起什么作用呢？
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.en: Environment does play a role.
sentences.zh: 环境确实起作用。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: You see there have been hotbeds of creativity throughout history.
sentences.zh: 纵观历史，一直存在孕育创造力的中心。

w.m: n.温床；孕育某事物的地方

sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: For example, the city of Florence during the Renaissance period was home to both Leonardo da Vinci and Michelangelo.
sentences.zh: 例如，文艺复兴时期，莱昂纳多·达·芬奇和米开朗琪罗都曾生活在佛罗伦萨。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: Both men in fact came from families that didn’t especially value creativity, yet someone noticed a spark of talent in them and both got the training and financial backing to produce extraordinary pieces of art.
sentences.zh: 实际上，两人都来自并不特别重视创造力的家庭，但有人发现了他们显露出的才华，他们也都获得了培训和资金支持，从而创作出杰出的艺术作品。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: Uh, since the environment helps in the creative process, are there ways for people to build a better, more creative brain?
sentences.zh: 既然环境能帮助人们进行创造，那么，有什么方法能让大脑变得更好、更有创造力吗？
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.en: Well, I’d suggest that you spend 30 minutes a day on a creativity workout.
sentences.zh: 我建议，每天花三十分钟进行创造力训练。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: Oh, could you say a bit more about that?
sentences.zh: 您能再具体说说吗？
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.en: Yes, you do three things.
sentences.zh: 可以。你需要做三件事。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: First, explore an unfamiliar area of knowledge.
sentences.zh: 第一，探索一个不熟悉的知识领域。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: For example, people who use a lot of math on the job should sign up for a painting class.
sentences.zh: 例如，工作中经常用到数学的人，可以报名参加绘画课。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: And the second?
sentences.zh: 第二件呢？
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.en: The second is, spend time each day thinking.
sentences.zh: 第二，每天花时间思考。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: This means that you don’t censor your thoughts, but allow your mind to go freely to a problem and see what kind of solutions or ideas come up.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，不要审查、压制自己的想法，而要让思路围绕一个问题自由展开，看看会出现什么解决办法或念头。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: Next thing?
sentences.zh: 接下来呢？
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.en: That is, practice the art of paying attention.
sentences.zh: 接下来，就是练习专注观察的技巧。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: Look for and really observe a person, an object or something in your daily commute that you hadn’t noticed before.
sentences.zh: 在每天上下班或上学的路上，找一个以前没注意到的人、物体或其他事物，认真观察。

w.m: n.上下班或上学的日常往返

sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: Try describing or drawing that object in a journal or sketchbook.
sentences.zh: 试着在日记本或速写本上，描述或画下那个观察对象。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: I hope your advice will help people to train their brain to be creative.
sentences.zh: 希望您的建议能帮助人们训练大脑，提升创造力。
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.en: OK, thank you very much Dr. Andreasen for talking on the show.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢安德烈亚森博士参加我们的访谈节目。
sentences.speaker: M

sentences.en: Not at all.
sentences.zh: 不客气。
sentences.speaker: W

sentences.en: This is the end of part two of the interview.
sentences.zh: 访谈的第二部分到此结束。
sentences.asr_text: This is the end of part two of the interview.
sentences.speaker: announcer
